title: Mining the risk: early cardiovascular detection in workers.
summary: A retrospective longitudinal cohort of 89,045 Chilean mining workers (420,966 exams) was used to predict transitions in BMI and blood-glucose categories. Machine-learning models achieved test AUCs up to 0.95 for severe BMI progression and 0.83 for diabetes progression. This is a specific risk-progression result using proxy outcomes, not observed cardiovascular events.
